title_zh: 焦慮家長的自助線上課程能預防孩子焦慮嗎？1,811 人 RCT 的小效果與低完成率
title_en: Online program for anxious parents prevents child anxiety
summary_zh: ACAMH 部落格評介一項平行組隨機對照試驗（Dunn 等，2024）：1,811 名高焦慮家長（子女 2–11 歲）分為無人引導的線上模組組或控制組，模組每單元約 20 分鐘，涵蓋減少迴避、情緒教練、減少過度保護等。六個月時介入組子女的家長評焦慮顯著較低（d = −0.16），家長焦慮也下降；但約 32% 完成兩個以上模組、約 19% 全部完成。
summary_en: An ACAMH blog reviews a parallel-group RCT (Dunn et al., 2024) in which 1,811 highly anxious parents of children aged 2–11 were randomised to unguided online modules (about 20 minutes each, covering avoidance, emotion coaching, overprotection) or control. At six months, parent-reported child anxiety was significantly lower (d = −0.16) and parental anxiety also fell, but only about 32% completed two or more modules and about 19% completed all.
evidence_note: 部落格評介的原始研究為大型平行組隨機對照試驗；效果量小且以家長報告為主。

posts.title: Self-Guided Intervention for Intergenerational Anxiety
posts.content: ACAMH 部落格評介 Dunn 等人 2024 年 Lancet Regional Health – Europe 的 RCT：1,811 名高焦慮家長使用無人引導的線上模組，六個月時子女（2–11 歲）的家長評焦慮較低，但效果量小、完成率偏低。

related.title_zh: 青少年「失眠」可能是晝夜節律延遲：挪威研究近九成有相位後移指標
related.summary_zh: ACAMH 部落格整理挪威 3,867 名高中生的研究（Arnesen 等，2025）：34.5% 符合失眠標準，但其中 88.4% 呈現晝夜節律延遲的指標。作者建議評估上學日與假日的睡眠時間差、延後就寢是否改善入睡、週末補眠等；失眠以 CBT-I 處理，節律延遲則考慮光照、褪黑激素時機與逐步提前起床時間，而非只叫孩子早點上床。
related.summary_en: An ACAMH blog summarises a study of 3,867 Norwegian high-school students (Arnesen et al., 2025): 34.5% met insomnia criteria, yet 88.4% of these showed indicators of circadian delay. The author recommends assessing school-day vs free-day sleep timing, response to later bedtimes and weekend catch-up sleep; CBT-I for insomnia, and light, melatonin timing and gradual wake-time advances for circadian delay rather than simply earlier bedtimes.

related.title_zh: 青少年自傷：把每次接觸服務變成照護機會——英國 544 名自殺身亡青少年資料
related.title_en: Youth self-harm and service contact before suicide
related.summary_zh: ACAMH 部落格評介英國全國連續案例系列研究（Aggarwal 等，British Journal of Psychiatry, 2025）：544 名 10–19 歲自殺身亡者中 49% 有自傷紀錄、26% 有近期自傷；近期自傷者中 60% 在死亡前三個月內曾接觸心理健康服務，95% 經歷近期逆境。另有 51% 沒有自傷紀錄。作者建議評估不只看自傷行為，也要看關係、安全與環境壓力，並提供協調的個別化照護與 48 小時內的後續追蹤。
related.summary_en: An ACAMH blog reviews a UK consecutive case series (Aggarwal et al., British Journal of Psychiatry, 2025) of 544 young people aged 10–19 who died by suicide: 49% had a self-harm history and 26% recent self-harm; among those with recent self-harm, 60% had contact with mental health services in the prior three months and 95% had recent adversity, while 51% had no recorded self-harm. The author urges broader assessment of relationships, safety and stressors, coordinated care and 48-hour follow-up.

related.title_zh: 港大防自殺中心：學童自殺不能只歸咎「適應期」，前線守門員要補位
related.title_en: HKU CSRP: student suicides not explained by adjustment period
related.summary_zh: 港大香港賽馬會防止自殺研究中心高級培訓顧問張鳳儀接受東網訪問時指出，開學「適應期」可能帶來壓力，但不能充分解釋學童自殺；自殺通常由多重因素造成，約三成自殺離世學生生前曾被診斷有精神健康問題或有相關醫療服務紀錄。她建議加強前線教師的精神健康及防止自殺培訓、重視教師身心健康、建立人人都是「守門員」的文化，並加強家校合作。
related.summary_en: A senior training consultant at HKU's Centre for Suicide Research and Prevention told on.cc that the school 'adjustment period' cannot fully explain student suicides; about 30% of students who died by suicide had prior mental health diagnoses or service records. She urged gatekeeper training for teachers, attention to teacher wellbeing, and stronger home–school partnership.
